name: Fresh Pork Tenderloin Medallions (Seared in Olive Oil)
whyItWorks: Pork tenderloin is just as lean as skinless chicken breast (only 3g fat per 4 oz serving). Tender, mild, and high in thiamine (vitamin B1), without the tough sinew found in pork chops or roasts.
prepOrOrderInstructions: Slice tenderloin into 1-inch thick medallions. Sear in olive oil on medium heat for 3–4 minutes per side until 145°F with a light blush in the center.
